notes.title: Official Version Ver1.00.00 Released!
notes.notes:
Official Version Ver1.00.00 Released
Here are the patch notes:


Official Version Ver1.00.00 Released
Here are the patch notes:

[New Stage Addition]

・Added the final chapter "The Dream Labyrinth" .
・Added new enemies, weapons, and achievements.


[New Skills Added]

・Several new skills have been added.
All skills will be detailed on a separate page.


[Unit "+" Value Added]

Units will now gain a "+" value next to their name when they reach a certain level. The higher the "+" value, the greater the growth in HP, attack, and defense. These "+" values can be carried over even through job changes or inheritance.


[New Features]

・An auto-activation function for selected leader skills has been added.
・A relic reroll feature has been added.
These features can be unlocked in the unlock screen, allowing for use in-game and an increase in the number of uses.


[New Relics Added]

・A relic that activates when enemies step on traps.
・A relic that reduces the number of enemies that appear.
・A relic that increases the first attack in battle.
Several other new relics have been added.

[Relic Balance Adjustments]

・Some relics now require obtaining prerequisite relics before they can be acquired.


[Game Balance Adjustments]

・Added a level-up limit per battle/training session.
・Increased the experience required for advanced classes.
・Increased the recovery rate of units that did not participate in battle to 15%.
・Adjusted the stats of some enemies from Chapters 1 to 3.
・Adjusted the event timing for "Corrupt Wave".
・Adjusted the duration of combined status effects to match the longest status effect.
・Adjusted the cost for unlocking the inventory limit of inheritance units and weapons.


[Visual Adjustments]

・Facilities now blink when their effects are activated.
・Skill icon adjustments.
・Adjustments to certain UI elements.


[Other Adjustments]

・Adjusted camera movement values.
・Adjusted the ADV part text in Chapter 2.
・Added a tutorial.
・Other minor text corrections, bug fixes, and overall polish.

notes.title: Regarding the Official Release
notes.notes:
We will be updating with the official release, including the final chapter, on Saturday, October 19th. Below is a selection of the new features and adjustments that will be implemented.


[h3][b][New Stage Addition][/b][/h3]
The Final chapter, " The Dream Labyrinth" , will be added, concluding the story. Along with it, new enemies, weapons, and achievements will be introduced.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/223a774620790770f0b8dc7c498ae5c7f8d8ce0d.png[/img]


[h3][b][Addition of Unit "+" Values][/b][/h3]
Units can now gain a "+" value next to their name by reaching a certain level. The higher the "+" value, the greater the growth bonuses for HP, attack power, and defense. These "+" values can be carried over even through job changes or inheritance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/d3c61a53bdcb1e56a24dfb24ce6434a93687b8c2.png[/img]


[h3][b][New Skill Additions][/b][/h3]
・Assassin
JPS:Attacking Tactics___ATK and DEF increases by 5% with each attack until the end of the battle.Activates only when in Assassin class

・Warlock
JPS:White Night's Wrath___Gain 50％ ATK for each damage received until the end of the battle Activates only when in Warlock class

Several additional new skills and adjustments to existing skills will be made. 


[h3][b][New Features][/b][/h3]
・An auto-activation feature for leader skills has been added, allowing selected leader skills to be used automatically.
・A feature for rerolling relics has been added.
These functions will be added to the unlock screen, and you can unlock them to use them in-game or increase the number of times they can be used.


[h3][b][New Relics Added][/b][/h3]

・A relic that activates when enemies step on a trap.
・A relic that reduces the number of enemies that appear.
・A relic that increases the power of the first attack in battle.
Several other new relics have also been added.


[h3][b][Game Balance Adjustments][/b][/h3]
・The experience required for leveling up advanced jobs has increased, and a limit of 3 levels per battle or training session has been set.
・The recovery rate for units that did not participate in battle has been increased from 10% to 15%.
・The cost for unlocking the unit and weapon inventory limit has been adjusted.

I have updated the following items:

[b]New Implementations:[/b]

[list]
[*] Plaza Panel Implementation: Plaza panels where units can be placed will be randomly placed. Plaza panels allow unit placement even in unexplored areas if they are shallower than the current maximum depth. [*] Note: Panel selection occurs when entering a stage and when defeating a boss, so if you resume play with existing data, it will reflect the previous state. In such cases, clearing the stage once or restarting the stage will apply the updates.

[*] Druid Adjustments: Previously, the Yiguirro's Branch had a weapon ability that targeted multiple units within the effective range. Now it can heal units around a single unit within the effective range. Additionally, some of the Druid's skills have been adjusted accordingly.
[*] Adjustments made to the balance of some enemies.
[*] Timing adjustments for the appearance of strong enemies upon reaching the second tier within a stage.
[/list]

notes.title: Notice Regarding the Release of Chapter 3
notes.notes:
[b][h2]【Notice Regarding the Release of Chapter 3】
[/h2][/b]
On Saturday, January 27th, we will be implementing a major update that includes Chapter 3. The upcoming patch notes for the post-update changes are as follows.

[h3][b]【Addition of English Version】[/b][/h3]

Implementation of the English version for the game, excluding the Adventure part. Translating the ADV part is scheduled for a later date due to the complexity of context.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/d1a75cf77ce42d28506e827b780c75e89f416909.png[/img]

[h3][b]【Addition of Chapter 3 and New Stages】[/b][/h3]

Implementation of Chapter 3, featuring new enemies and weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/e1f765ef3a01d1a387f1495f3baf4531725ef728.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/2c9f55938817a8177c65db5864ac64a2a7b2a078.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/5967033e9a5020d9f7318a149d9a560d73a09545.png[/img]

[h3][b]【Inheritance and Unlock Elements Addition】[/b][/h3]

Inherited Units:
Inherited units allow you to carry over units you've raised to the next game, maintaining their skills and job at level 1. Use this as a flexible framework to experiment with various skill combinations, such as maximizing attack power or combining the best features of all jobs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/dc00ca9310df599f24b24771e8df7c8a95c749ef.png[/img]

Inherited Weapons:
Weapons, including their enhancement values, can be carried over to the next game. Train the most powerful weapons with beneficial effects or nurture special weapons dropped by bosses to aid in your strategies. However, it's important to note that inherited weapons cannot be used as enhancement materials for other weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/3bb34b9cadbf1efaabe5f790a8d50c3a73067256.png[/img]

Unlock Elements:
The number of inherited units and equipment slots that can be brought into the game will be expanded. Points required for unlocking can be obtained by clearing stages or, in the case of defeat, based on the progress made. Increasing your pledge level will make it easier to accumulate more points, so consider taking on the challenge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/0fda127ca4ba40c83c8348be6e9e6eb82e27d733.png[/img]

Additionally, various other updates will be implemented.

notes.title: ◆1月時点の開発進捗について
notes.notes:
あけましておめでとうございます。
　1月の開発進捗についてです。

　三章のADVパートも一息つき、新しいゲームサイクルに必要なUIも揃い、大まかな機能としては完成しました。
　新機能である引継ぎ要素の紹介になります。

[b]■引継ぎ要素[/b]
・継承ユニット
　継承ユニットはスキルと職業をそのままにレベル１の状態でゲームに参加します。
　スキルの組み合わせを自由に試せる枠として、最強の攻撃力とか、全部の職業のいいとこどりとか、色々試してみてください。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/f0011017a658f5338e9c8f4d63e01438abfcce1d.png[/img]

・継承武器
　武器に関しては強化値などをそのままに引継ぎます。
　最強の付与効果の武器を鍛えたり、ボスが落とす特殊な武器を育てるもよし、攻略の役に立ててください。

　ただし、注意事項として継承してきた武器は他の武器の強化素材にする事はできません。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/663469500abfe0e164553d9dec59bccae7dda45b.png[/img]

[b]■解放要素[/b]
　継承ユニット、装備の枠。持ち込める数を解放できるようになります。
　解放に必要なポイントはステージをクリアすると貰える他、敗北時にもそこまでの進捗により付与されます。

　誓約レベルを上げる事でより多くのポイントを集めやすくなるので、挑戦してみてください。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/4b02eadc33edb8ac3f9fbdaec86b4d7f8ccb542f.png[/img]


　第三章のリリースに関して、今月内を予定していますのでお待ちいただければ。

notes.title: ◆Progress in December
notes.notes:
Currently, I am mainly working on the production of Chapter 3.
For the Chapter 3 update, we plan to add new stages and story content. Additionally, on the functional side, we are mainly focusing on localization and improvements to the game cycle.


・Addition of the English Version
 This is expected to be mostly completed by mid-November, entering the debugging phase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/d1a75cf77ce42d28506e827b780c75e89f416909.png[/img]

・Game Cycle
The game cycle for the Chapter 3 update will include the inheritance of unit classes, skills, and weapons. Players will earn points through stage clears or defeats, which can be used to unlock the number of inheritances. By playing repeatedly, players will become stronger, making it easier to conquer challenges.

However, the stages are primarily designed to be clearable without inheritance, so players aiming for achievements can challenge themselves to clear without inheriting vows.


・UI Adjustments
UI adjustments during battles will be made. Real-time information on ally skill activations and HP changes will be visible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/b53157b6d0389278785afcf8ace22e5a169220a3.png[/img]

・Other Balance Adjustments:
Adjustments will be made to improve the usability of leader skills and classes.


We will report soon regarding the release schedule for Chapter 3 and other details.

notes.title: 第二章公開につきまして
notes.notes:
10月の7日17時頃
Ver0.02アップデートで追加された要素の中からいくつかピックアップして紹介させていただきます。


【ステージ追加】
第二章、追憶の狂騎士　ライゼンシャハ
亡国ルクレガニア最後の騎士であり使徒。奪った命を得る代わりに、一日に一人、殺す事を義務付けられた。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/c34c1f6731db3502de240dfde9a18b5e20d49499.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/42c0b21b1668c42d7eb37c78d15421b6ca47886f.png[/img]

【特殊能力を持つエネミーの追加】
ステージ2からは新たに特殊な能力を持ったエネミーが登場します。
ここではその一部を紹介します。

・飛翔する者
空を飛び、近接型ユニットの攻撃を受けずブロックが不可能なエネミーです。
弓や魔法系のジョブのユニットを配置したり、リーダースキルを利用することで対策しましょう。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/402a45e8eac3c196c8ec718c9af53745cf48aac4.png[/img]

・舞い散る悲嘆
発火の状態異常になると防御力が低下するエネミーです。
しかし防御力が下がる代わりに別のなにかが起きるようで…？
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/4801000c3015d1c834de2c8e05980df406b75a8f.png[/img]


【UI・UX改善】
・出現するエネミーを確認できる画面の追加
戦闘準備に現在の階層で出現するエネミーのステータスを表示する機能を追加しました。
またボス戦闘の時には敵の詳しい出現数まで確認できるようになっています。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/a6630c440226cc31b8b82a0774f5b771588edf80.png[/img]


重ね重ねになりますが、これらの内容はアップデートの一部になります。
新しいスキルやイベント、細かなバランス調整など多数の更新があります。
ぜひステージ2をプレイして確かめてみてください。

今後もステージ追加や、多言語対応などアップデートを続けてまいります。
これからもユメノメイキュウを楽しんでいただけますと幸いです。

notes.title: 第二章アップデートについて
notes.notes:
10月7日土曜日に第二章を含む大きなアップデートを行います。
　以下パッチノートになります。


【第二章新ステージの追加】
　・第二章では新しい敵、フィールドイベント、武器、パネルなどが解放されます
　・新しい敵には近接攻撃が届かず、施設やリーダースキルで対処が必要な飛行するタイプなども追加されます。


【新規スキルの追加、及び施設のバランス調整】
　・新スキルJPS(ジョブ専用パッシブスキル)の追加。JPSは特定のジョブでしか有効にならないスキルですが、普通のパッシブスキルより強力なものになります
　・回復職以外の回復スキルを使用した際、回復力を50％に調整
　・一部のスキル。基本的には弱いスキルを強化する方針で調整
　・施設、各属性のトラップについて威力を全体的に上昇


【敵の調整】
　・ボスが時間経過により受けるダメージを調整
　・準備フェーズで敵の情報を確認できるようになった影響で第一章の出現する敵のタイミングとドロップする武器を調整


【UIの新機能、改修】
　・出現する敵の情報を準備フェーズで確認できるようになりました。また、ボスや一度負けて固定された敵の出現状況なども確認できます
　・敵の情報の中に各属性の耐久値が表示されます。この数値以上の属性値を与えると状態異常を起こすようになります。属性値は各スキル及び施設に表示されるようになりました
　・掘れるパネルをマウスオーバーする事で、そのパネルの情報を確認できるようになりました
　・他、細かいUIの調整等


【実績の追加】
　・第二章用の実績を追加
　・指定ターン以内でのクリアを目指す実績を追加
